artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Committed on wk-NFRA_FIDUPL-7 (LOCAL) at dd0f7996831 (REPAIR 1 of b8c032fc2d). The box command: main(argv, deps) signs in once, reads the book (column 0 of the newest landed account.txt), walks it over transactions (365-day windows back from one anchor; stop at two consecutive empty windows or an empty window of index 5 or higher; window cap 10; split at 2,000 rows), realized lots (one 30-year range split by date until totalCount matches) and open lots (one snapshot per account by New York day). Each answer lands raw as compact ASCII JSON at opal_naming.address with metadata earliest (the answer's earliest row date); a skipped window or range folds its metadata earliest. State saved every 25 accounts and on every stop; one run record under _runs; named stops auth, throttled, budget, terminated, error, account_cap, surface_end, all_done.

surprises: NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W7-S7: the order's measured facts do not say whether accountNumber and accountNumbers take a JSON string or a JSON number; the walk sends the book's string, unconverted.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W7-S8: the ten-window transactions cap (3,650 days) ends an account with older history as ERROR on every run, against the cell's 'as far back as the API serves'.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W7-S9: a one-day transactions window that answers 2,000 rows or more cannot be split; the order names no rule, so it lands and the account is INCOMPLETE.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W7-S10: the run stop 'surface_end' (every surface walked once while an ERROR account awaits its retry) is not among the stops the order names.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W7-S11: the state entries carry rows and attempts, and an in-progress account is saved with result null, beyond the order's {result, earliest}.
NFRA_FIDUPL-D1-W7-S12: the order gives no metadata for open-lots objects; the walk writes sha256, rows and total.
